newsitem.title: USA: Biosense Corp IPO withdrawn - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: Biosense Corp IPO withdrawn - underwriter.

text.p: The initial public offering of Biosense Inc has been withdrawn, underwriters for the deal said Monday.
UBS Securities said the offering was pulled but did not provide a reason for the withdrawal.
Terms of the deal were not provided in a U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filing, although the registration did say shares were to trade on the Nasdaq National Market under the symbol BSEN.O.
Biosense Corp is a developer of technology enabling physicians to navigate medical instruments in patients' bodies during minor surgery.
